description.para: Defines the commands which may be sent to the Flash device.
Defines the bank register, die erase, and flag status commands.
The bank register is called Extended Address Register in Micron.
Defines the status register 2 commands and the Winbond quad enable bit.
Defines the offsets within a FlashBuffer data type for each kind of data.
The read data offset is not the same as the write data offset. The QSPIPSU driver allows full duplex transfers, so the number of bytes received is the number sent and received.

briefdescription.para: MSB byte of address to read or write.
Middle byte of address to read or write.
LSB byte of address to read or write.
LSB byte of address to read or write when 4-byte address.
Dummy byte offset for fast, dual and quad reads.
Number of dummy bytes for fast, dual and quad reads.
Number of dummy bytes for fast, dual and quad reads.
Read ID command + 3 bytes ID response.
BRWR or EARWR command + 1 byte bank value.
1 byte Configuration register + RD CFG command.
WRR command + 1 byte each Status and Config Reg.

description.para: Defines the status/configuration register volatile address offsets.
Defines the status/configuration register nonvolatile address offsets.

Micron: Byte 0 is Manufacturer ID; Byte 1 is first byte of Device ID - 0xBB or 0xBA Byte 2 is second byte of Device ID describes flash size: 128Mbit : 0x18; 256Mbit : 0x19; 512Mbit : 0x20 Spansion: Byte 0 is Manufacturer ID; Byte 1 is Device ID - Memory Interface type - 0x20 or 0x02 Byte 2 is second byte of Device ID describes flash size: 128Mbit : 0x18; 256Mbit : 0x19; 512Mbit : 0x20

briefdescription.para: Specifies the extra bytes which are sent to the Flash on the QSPIPSU interface.

detaileddescription.para: These bytes are not data, but control information which includes the command and address.

briefdescription.para: Mask for quad enable bit in Flash configuration register.
Flash configuration table for the supported flash parts.
Finds the flash configuration table index for a flash JEDEC ID.

parameterdescription.para: JEDEC ID read from the flash device.
Pointer to the flash configuration table index.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the JEDEC ID is found in the table.
XST_FAILURE if the JEDEC ID is not found in the table.

briefdescription.para: Calculates the clock prescaler for a baud rate divisor.
Provides the flash configuration table and defines for the examples.
